trap.label: vírgulas
trap.wrong: Her paper which won the prize, argues that freedom is achieved through others.
trap.right: Her paper, which won the prize, argues that freedom is achieved through others.
trap.why: A relativa não restritiva leva vírgulas e which; em português a vírgula é facultativa.

opts: Her paper, which won the prize, …
Her paper that, won the prize,
Her paper which won, the prize

mcq.q: In a non-restrictive clause, don’t use…

fix.wrong: Her paper, that won the prize, is good.
fix.right: Her paper, which won the prize, is good.

fix.wrong: Her paper which won the prize, is good.
fix.right: Her paper, which won the prize, is good.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “Her paper won the prize. It is good.”
rewrite.answer: Her paper, which won the prize, is good.
